The '''Khalari Emirates''' is a federal constitutional monarchy established in 1979. It is a Khalari state shown near the eastern edge of the 2003 and 2022 reference maps.

== Government ==

The source presents the state as a federal constitutional monarchy led by a Grand Emir and a Prime Minister, with a bicameral parliament divided into a Federal Senate and Federal Assembly. The source names Edran Naros and Seran Arna, but this draft does not assign them a specific 1994 office date until leadership chronology is reviewed.

== Society ==

The source identifies Khalarian and Dhali as languages and lists Khalar, Dhali, Thanuli, and others among the population. It also names Khalari Monotheism and Southern Dhal among the religious traditions.

== Source Limits ==

This draft preserves the 1979 establishment date and state profile without deciding whether all infobox population, area, and leader details are valid for the 1994-back pass or later map years.
